# webhook.link

> > Open-source webhook testing and HTTP request logging tool for developers

webhook.link is an open-source platform created by Gabriel Bordeaux that enables developers to test webhooks, inspect HTTP requests, and debug API integrations in real-time without requiring custom server setup.

## Key Topics

- webhook testing
- HTTP request logging
- API testing
- webhook debugging
- open-source tools
- request inspection
- Gabriel Bordeaux
- GitHub integration
- developer tools
- HTTP testing

## Core Platform

- [Webhook](https://webhook.link/): Open-source webhook testing and HTTP request logging tool by Gabriel Bordeaux
